items.title: Banks consider turning GPH Ispat loans into bonds
items.description: Around two dozen banks are exploring an alternative to loan rescheduling to rescue GPH Ispat, a steelmaker struggling under liabilities of about Tk 12,000 crore as business slumps.

items.title: Banking reforms welcome, but political will is key
items.description: Banking is one of the biggest problems facing the country’s economy. Its troubles began to deepen in the final months of the Awami League government.

items.title: Turkish group Sanko plans $300m denim factory
items.description: Turkish industrial conglomerate Sanko Holding, through its denim division ISKO, plans to invest $300 million in a denim manufacturing plant at the Shreehatta Economic Zone in Moulvibazar in partnership with local conglomerate DBL Group.

items.title: Tk 1.73 lakh crore stuck in 47,500 cases of six state banks
items.description: Nearly 47,500 cases involving unpaid loans of six state-owned banks are pending across the country, with about Tk 1.73 lakh crore tied up in them, according to internal Bangladesh Bank data.

items.title: Japan’s Maruhisa opens second factory
items.description: Japanese garment maker Maruhisa Group yesterday announced the official launch of its second factory in Bangladesh, in Narayanganj, which began production in October with a planned total investment of Tk 100 crore.

items.title: Brent drops to $91
items.description: Crude oil prices steadied on Wednesday as the prospect of a market surplus offset concerns about disruptions to oil exports in the Middle East.
